mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.* FROM sys_rule r INNER JOIN sys_role_rule rr ON r.id = rr.rule_id WHERE rr.role_id = #{roleId} AND r.frontpath IS NOT NULL AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.order_num ASC
SELECT DISTINCT r.`condition` FROM sys_rule r INNER JOIN sys_role_rule rr ON r.id = rr.rule_id WHERE rr.role_id = #{roleId} AND r.`condition` IS NOT NULL AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0
